mentions.name: Quantra
mentions.description: Open source quantitative finance pricing platform built on top of QuantLib. Acts as a distributed QuantLib, exposing pricing, curve construction, and risk analytics through APIs with an abstraction layer, so applications can integrate QuantLib functionality without working with the C++ library directly.
mentions.problem: Working with QuantLib directly means dealing with its C++ library, which is hard to integrate with applications.
mentions.audience: Developers building applications that need quantitative finance pricing and risk analytics without integrating the C++ QuantLib library directly
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building an open source quantitative finance pricing platform built on top of QuantLib.

Think of it as a distributed QuantLib, exposing pricing, curve construction, risk analytics... through APIs, making QuantLib easy to integrate with applications without having to deal with the C++ library directly and an extra layer of abstraction on top of it.

evidence.value:
I'm building an open source quantitative finance pricing platform built on top of QuantLib.

Think of it as a distributed QuantLib, exposing pricing, curve construction, risk analytics... through APIs, making QuantLib easy to integrate with applications without having to deal with the C++ library directly and an extra layer of abstraction on top of it.
